# Cncf Nirmata Cloud Native Policy Manager Reviewer

Review Nirmata Cloud Native Policy Manager using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. The solution enables DevSecOps teams to ensure the security, compliance, and operational readiness of their Kubernetes workloads and clusters. By automating the creation, deployment, and lifecycle management of policy-based Intelligent Guardrails, customers can gain insights, alerts, and reports, and enable effective collaboration across development and operations teams.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
